scope: 40 MVP profiles across five families; 25 implemented in scope including Cougar; 16 Goblin/Dragon profiles deferred, full 56-profile catalogue preserved
source: Specification v0.9 approved MVP profiles; accepted D01–D22

checks.requirement: Seven complete eight-level families, exact ratings and ordinary attack values
testNames: contains exactly seven families and eight unique named profiles per family
<family> level %i preserves approved ratings and portable core data

checks.requirement: Independent portable blueprint copies and invalid-level rejection
testNames: returns isolated copies and rejects unknown levels without falling back to a generic creature

checks.requirement: Twenty-eight implemented including three deferred profiles; twenty-five in current MVP supported summon profiles use approved production data; unfinished profiles remain gated
testNames: matches the enabled engine creatures without enabling unfinished profiles

checks.requirement: Explicit creature caster pools, caps and spell lists
testNames: preserves the four explicit caster pools, caps and spell lists

checks.requirement: Multiattacks, independent breath types, D01–D08 requirements
testNames: keeps compound attacks in one action and alternative breaths out of bite sequences
records D01–D08 ability choices rather than losing them in generic attacks

checks.requirement: Undead/corpse exceptions and reanimation attack stripping
testNames: retains physical immunity exceptions and corpse exclusions
does not turn magical projectiles or poison production into reanimated body attacks

checks.requirement: Siege attack values, minimum ranges, split damage and immobility
testNames: keeps siege minimum ranges, areas, components and immobility distinct

checks.requirement: Every named special ability has an explicit integration requirement
testNames: has an explicit integration requirement for every special ability

checks.requirement: Aim, Brace, Ambush, Rally and close-range disadvantage use authoritative portable context; schema 11 migrates legacy saves explicitly
testNames: Brace deals two additional Guard damage through the production attack resolver and restore
Aim and longbow close disadvantage read planned and actual movement and target distance
Rally excludes self, enemies and incapacitated sources and never stacks
Ambush sees phase-local activity, survives restore and resets at the phase boundary
pending attack fixtures retain traits and phase history through exact continuation

checks.requirement: Hydra multiattack, regeneration, vulnerabilities and restoration; tiger Bleeding and illusion reversal; explicit content migration
testNames: Hydra resolves three bites as one action, wasting invalid subtargets without replacement
Hydra vulnerability and %s suppress regeneration for only that turn
Hydra can regenerate from incapacitation but never from death; reanimation removes regeneration
sabre-toothed tiger applies persistent Bleeding with correct illusion provenance (%s)

checks.requirement: Vine grappling and escape, Spectre Wither and incorporeality, three creature caster pools/caps and restoration, explicit content-v2 migration
testNames: vine uses two distinct tendrils at reach two against equal-sized targets and cannot take a third hold
Spectre Wither requires damage and retains reversible illusion provenance (%s)
%s level %i pays from its own mana, respects its cap and restores its pending cast
explicitly migrates content v2 without changing creature data, RNG, pending attack or phase activity

checks.requirement: Bristles retaliation and life drain with provenance, immunity, compound attacks, schema migration and restoration
testNames: Bristles triggers only on a damaging melee hit (%s)
Bristles still retaliates against a lethal damaging hit, and illusion retaliation reverses
Wraith drains only damaging hits on a living real target (%s)
permanent %s fixture resumes exactly through all attack boundaries
Bristles incapacitation stops remaining compound-attack bites without another retaliation loop
schema-11 content-v3 migration supplies neutral on-hit traits and preserves pending work

checks.requirement: D01 Marked Quarry action cost, selected attack bonus, persistence, visibility, cleanup and versioned continuation
testNames: selection costs the normal action and survives every atomic boundary and the next turn
changing quarry replaces the bonus; losing a target clears it without selecting another
the selected bonus affects production hit rolls, not merely the preview
permanent %s fixture resumes identically at every atomic boundary
schema-12 migration preserves existing on-hit state without granting Marked Quarry

checks.requirement: Siege reload cycle, area Guard, arcing and typed area damage, owner views, schema migration and atomic continuation
testNames: fire/reload/fire uses three turns and restores exactly at every attack boundary
area Guard shoots the first qualifying entrant and retains its locked impact through restore
Double Action cannot bypass the fire/reload exclusion
real explosions finish after controller death; dispelled illusion attacks stop (%s)
permanent %s fixture resumes identically through every atomic step
schema-13 migration retains quarry state and grants no reload capability
owner views expose independent reload state while opponents receive no private readiness or quarry state

checks.requirement: Siege Catapult double structure damage, unchanged creature damage, illusion restrictions and schema-15 continuation
testNames: Siege Catapult doubles structure damage once per segment without doubling creature damage
illusory siege shots cannot damage structures but still damage intelligent creatures
permanent mid-impact fixture resumes without repeating structure damage
legacy validator rejects new structure abilities instead of silently changing old saves

checks.requirement: Ballista two-body penetration, exact geometry, independent rolls, Guard, illusions and versioned continuation
testNames: penetration follows one ray, includes allies and never selects a third body
two victims get independent damage, second base damage rounds up before defence, and restore is exact
a miss on the first creature still permits an independent second hit
ranged Guard uses the same two-body ray and spends only one loaded bolt
permanent second-hit fixture resumes exactly and rejects extra or self victims

checks.requirement: Elven Archer explicit arrow choices, defences, Darkness, Guard, illusions, reanimation and portable continuation
testNames: selected %s arrow uses its own damage type with exact continuation
physical arrows can outperform magic arrows against magic resistance
Darkness attack disadvantage is ignored without granting visibility through the area
reanimation retains physical archery but removes magical arrows
permanent %s arrow fixture retains the chosen shot across restore

checks.requirement: Owner-approved deferral of Goblin and Dragon; five-family books, awards and summon-order gating
testNames: five-family MVP retains 40 profiles and 12 non-summoning families
new spellbooks and repeated awards never include deferred families
%s cannot start a new cast even if retained in an old spellbook

checks.requirement: Treant reach, damage defences, regeneration, illusion interactions, plant immunities and portable continuation
testNames: Treant reaches two hexes from its footprint and restores every atomic step
regeneration revives damage incapacitation, caps health and never restores dead Treants
intelligent Treants take illusion damage that reverses for survivors

checks.requirement: Haunting Shade creature passage, legal endpoints, walls, Guard, Chill and portable transit
testNames: Shade crosses %s bodies with exact per-step restoration
interruption while passing through a body returns to the last legal resting hex
damaging Chill uses Int resistance and reversible illusion provenance (%s)
permanent mid-transit fixture restores overlap and continues to a legal endpoint

checks.requirement: Cougar Pounce uses resolved approach steps, target revalidation, base damage/defences, Guard exclusions, displacement resets, illusions, reanimation and schema-20 continuation
testNames: Cougar approaches three steps then bites for five with exact atomic continuation
a retreat or sideways step breaks the final approach run
terrain cost is not extra approach distance
Pounce rechecks the selected target at its current footprint without substitution
forced movement clears approach history
illusory Pounce damage reverses for survivors
permanent %s fixture resumes identically at every atomic boundary
schema-19 migration preserves transit without granting Pounce or history
